palindrome:
Here is a palindrome for you:

Able was I ere I saw Elba

This short palindrome has only 15 characters. However, if we allow repetition and extend it to include words or phrases, there are many possibilities. One longer example could be:

Was it a car or a cat I saw?

This palindrome also uses repetition of the word "was" and "saw", making it a bit more than just a simple reversal of a phrase. It has 19 characters.

For a much longer example, we can use phrases or sentences that read the same backward as forward:

Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam

This palindrome uses repetition of words and a comma, and includes punctuation. It has 28 characters.

I hope this helps!
